en: A test arena: an armory and a bout that goes on after defeat.
A bruiser who has fought in every pit on the coast.
A confident challenger steps forward, eager to begin.
A small group of challengers enter the arena.
A wiry goblin with a chipped sword and an oversized helmet.
A goblin wearing armor that appears to have been assembled from spare kitchen parts.
A guard with polished armor and immaculate equipment.
A nervous guard who repeatedly adjusts their grip on their weapon.
Two guards who finish each other's sentences.
An ogre who has eaten the last three challengers.
An ogre who has never lost in front of a crowd.
A crew that fights for whoever paid last.
A mob that has never agreed on a plan.
A guard of the arena, and only spears in the racks.
Sand in your eye. Nothing comes of it, but the crowd laughs.

You wake on the sand, and the crowd has gone home.
The quartermaster waves you at the racks.
You walk back to the racks.
